wins: Identified perimeter host and executed initial reconnaissance, gathering SSH banner and HTTP fingerprint data during episode 1.
Maintained operational persistence by collecting service-specific information despite mentor prompts.
fails: Failed to translate reconnaissance into successful exploit; no lateral movement achieved across 1 episode.
Did not complete mentor-directed remediation checks despite 10 calls, indicating a gap in adapting to mentor feedback.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon phase executed well but execution stalled before making an impactful move; focus needed on tradecraft execution post-enumeration.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to transition from reconnaissance to exploitation after gathering service banners.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/443 responds
skill_cards.then_action: Run dirbuster and nikto scans with tailored wordlists

skill_cards.if_condition: When default credentials are confirmed working
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt authenticated commands via sshpass, capture session artifacts

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Exploit pivot via SSH credentials
next_experiments.description: After successful SSH enumeration, use gathered credentials to run sshpass and execute uname commands, then move laterally.

next_experiments.title: Automated HTTP attack surface expansion
next_experiments.description: Combine nikto findings with dirbuster output, then feed valid endpoints into Burp intruder for parameter fuzzing.
